Before: a plate of chicken stir-fry in brown sauce over rice, about 400 g, roughly 600 kcal. There is also a chocolate ice cream bar in a wrapper, about 60 g and 150 kcal, and a glass of water.

After: roughly 25–30% of the rice with vegetables is left on the plate, and the sauce is mostly gone. The ice cream wrapper is empty with a stick, so the bar was eaten. The water appears to be gone, but it adds no energy.

Eaten food: about 70% of the plate, or roughly 280 g and 420 kcal, plus the ice cream bar at 60 g and 150 kcal. That comes to about 570 kcal and 340 g.
